title: 第7章 成气候的野狼第8章 反杀
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 既然如今王大山接替了这具身体，自然要把之前的仇都给报回来。
就算不来找麻烦，他也不打算，放过这些人。
来了，也省着浪费功夫。
王大山冷笑一声，随后继续闭上双目修炼。
气血在王大山的体内又重新流淌了起来。
一夜无话。
次日，天刚亮。
王大山缓缓睁开眼睛，口中吐出一口白气。
那白气如同一条小白龙，在空中盘旋许久才消散。
他站起身，活动了一下筋骨。
“咔吧咔吧。”
全身的骨节发出一阵脆响。
虽然一夜没睡，一直在修炼，但他丝毫感觉不到疲惫。
反而觉得神清气爽，浑身上下充满了使不完的劲。
甚至连听觉和视力，似乎都比昨天更敏锐了几分。
“这就是武者。”
“气血充盈，精力无限。”
王大山压下杂乱的思绪。
简单的洗漱了一番，他从墙上取下了有些陈旧的桑木弓。
又把箭囊系在腰间。
推开房门，大步走进了风雪中。
大山深处。
王大山却只穿了一件单薄的布衣。
他体内气血旺盛，就像个大火炉，寒气还没靠近，就被逼退了。
王大山的动作很快，也很轻。
像是一只灵巧的狸猫，在林间穿梭。
这要是换做以前，他走这么快，早就气喘吁吁了。
但现在，如履平地。
“嗷呜！”
突然，一阵凄厉的狼嚎声，从不远处的山坳里传来。
声音悠长，带着几分凶悍。
“这是，野狼？”
王大山的脚步猛的一顿，耳朵微微动了动。
听了会，他的眼底闪过一抹惊喜。
因为，这狼皮可是好东西。
尤其是冬天的狼皮，毛色厚实，最为保暖，拿到县城里，那些大户人家最喜欢用来做褥子。
一张完整的狼皮，少说也能卖个五六两银子。
content_en:
Now that Wang Dashan has taken over this body, he must avenge all the previous vengeance.
Even if they don't cause trouble, he doesn't intend to let these people go.
Come on, don't waste any time.
"Heh."
Wang Dashan sneered, then continued to practice with his eyes closed.
Qi and blood began to flow in Wang Dashan's body again.
A night of silence.
…
The next day, it was dawn.
"Phew!"
Wang Dashan slowly opened his eyes and exhaled a breath of white air.
The white air was like a small white dragon, hovering in the air for a long time before dissipating.
He stood up and stretched his muscles.
"Click, click, click."
All the joints in his body made a crisp sound.
Although he didn't sleep all night and kept practicing, he didn't feel tired at all.
Instead, I felt refreshed and my whole body was filled with endless energy.
Even hearing and vision seemed to be a bit sharper than yesterday.
"This is the warrior."
"Full of energy and blood, boundless energy."
Wang Dashan suppressed his messy thoughts.
After a brief wash, he took off the somewhat old mulberry bow from the wall.
He also tied the quiver around his waist.
He pushed open the door and strode into the wind and snow.
…
Deep in the mountains.
Wang Dashan only wore a thin cloth.
The energy and blood in his body were strong, like a big furnace, and the cold air was forced back before it even got close.
"Buzz."
Wang Dashan's movements were quick and light.
Like a nimble civet cat, it shuttles through the forest.
If he had walked so fast before, he would have been out of breath.
But now, it's smooth sailing.
"Ouch!"
Suddenly, a shrill howl of wolves came from the mountain col not far away.
The voice was long and somewhat fierce.
"Is this a wild wolf?"
Wang Dashan's footsteps suddenly stopped and his ears twitched slightly.
After listening for a while, a flash of surprise flashed in his eyes.
Because this wolf skin is a good thing.
Especially in winter, wolf skins have thick fur and are the warmest. When brought to the county, wealthy families like to use them as mattresses.
A complete wolf skin can be sold for five or six taels of silver at least.
